age_convention: START_DATE is treated as an already-planted 18-month-old palm; age advances by elapsed days / 30.4375. This is a simulation convention.
weather_source: NASA POWER daily point API or explicitly supplied snapshot

scenarios.tnau_guided_irrigation: 45 L/palm every four days only when age is 18 to <24 months and month is in configured dry-season months. This is a simplified scenario derived from a TNAU source summary, not a complete official schedule.

irrigation_assumptions.effective_wetted_area_status: placeholder only; must be measured or supported before interpreting irrigation mm
irrigation_assumptions.source_scope: TNAU summary refers to 45 L/seedling every four days during dry summer months in the first two years after planting; verify current official page.
irrigation_assumptions.age_24_to_36_months: No TNAU irrigation schedule assumed by this script for age >=24 months.

formulas.water_balance: pre_drainage = previous_storage + effective_rainfall + irrigation - actual_ET; drainage = max(0, pre_drainage - TAW); storage = clip(pre_drainage - drainage, 0, TAW)
formulas.soil_moisture: linear mapping between modelled storage and assumed FC/WP; not sensor calibrated

provisional_parameters.status: Prototype assumptions requiring evidence, site soil data and/or field calibration.

validation.weather_completeness: checked for configured date range, duplicates and missing required values
validation.water_balance: storage bounded and drainage closes bucket overflow arithmetically
validation.scenario_comparison: same daily weather used for both scenarios

limitations: NASA POWER is gridded weather data, not on-farm sensor measurements.
ET0 implementation approximates actual vapour pressure using daily mean relative humidity.
Kc, root depth, FC, WP, runoff, initial storage and stress threshold are provisional.
The age clock is a simulation convention, not a real planting record.
The dry-season month list is provisional and needs local verification.
The wetted area is a placeholder and materially affects irrigation depth.
Soil temperature is not modelled and is stored as missing with an explanatory status.
Stress labels and moisture values are model-derived, not ground truth.
The irrigation scenario is not a farm-specific recommendation.
